performance.verdict: No paid activity; 5 overdue milestones are blocking any revenue signal.

findings.text: Pre-Launch Stack Test, LSA Verification, and Site/Landing Pages were due 2026-07-31 — all 3 still unconfirmed, now 33 days overdue.
Ads Launch (LSA + Search) and Meta Retargeting were due 2026-08-01 — both unconfirmed; 0 spend across 28 days confirms no go-live occurred.
Spend efficiency is unmeasurable: $0 spend and 0 leads across the full 28-day window; CPL is undefined with no baseline established.
GBP actions fell from ~28 (prior 7d) to 16 (last 7d), a -42.86% drop; last 3 days show 0 actions vs. prior 3-day avg of ~2.7 — a confirmed 3-day signal, not noise.
GHL shows 118 contacts and 18 opportunities created but 0 appointments and 0 won — intake routing and calendar booking appear unbuilt, consistent with Month 1 SOW incomplete.

suggestions.text: Escalate all 5 overdue SOW milestones to Nacer immediately; no ad spend can go live until stack test and site are confirmed.
suggestions.monday_update: Five SOW milestones are unconfirmed and between 32–33 days overdue: Pre-Launch Stack Test, LSA Verification, Site & Landing Pages (due 2026-07-31), and both Ads Launch and Meta Retargeting Launch (due 2026-08-01). Zero spend over 28 days confirms no go-live has occurred. Success is defined as Nacer providing confirmed completion dates for all 5 items. This must be resolved before any media budget is activated.

suggestions.text: Audit GHL intake: 18 opportunities created, 0 appointments booked — confirm routing, calendar, and booking links are live.

suggestions.text: Watch GBP daily actions; 3-day total is 0 — if zero continues through 2026-09-05, investigate listing suspension.
